title.narrative: Mitra Plumbon Hospitals Inclusive Care Project

description.narrative: The project will finance up to Rp415 billion from ADB's OCR in the form of a senior secured sustainability linked loan (SLL) to fund a greenfield hospital in Batang in Central Java and the expansion of the existing hospital in Cirebon in West Java of Mitra Plumbon Healthcare (MPH). MPH is an operator of private hospitals primarily in West Java, Indonesia. It operates five hospitals with total of 1,997 beds as of June 2025, mainly serving patients under the national health insurance scheme (JKN).
